asA: chain author on a downstream product (a Worker-style web app or a library), and the verifier recording the result
iWant: to declare my app entry and harness once and have the result recorded beside the TEST verdict
soThat: Finalise reads test strength for the reviewed head without running anything
title: A chain author on a downstream product declares its entry and harness and the verifier records the result for Finalise

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture branch whose HEAD is a REVIEW: commit adding a MERGE/PASS review.json for H touching AC-101-1, and a passing test-strength run, when rcf audit test-strength --record runs, then it exits 0 and writes rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test-strength.json parsing as TestStrengthReport v1 with head the full sha of H, scope "reviewVerdict" and criteria [AC-101-1]; a FAIL run with --record writes the report too (result fail) and exits 4.

[failure] Given an uncommitted change to src/x.js, rcf audit test-strength --record exits 4 with stderr "test-strength: refused: working tree is dirty; a record names a committed head"; given a "BUILD:" commit after H that changed src/x.js, it exits 4 with "test-strength: refused: HEAD differs from the reviewed head <H7> outside rcf/verdicts/, rcf/verify-reports/ and FINALISE classes"; given no REVIEW verdict reachable from HEAD, with or without --acs or --fbs, it exits 2 with "test-strength: --record needs a REVIEW verdict reachable from HEAD"; none writes a file, and a FINALISE: commit inside FINALISE classes after H does not refuse.

[happy] Given a fixture Worker-style app whose rcf/test-strength.json declares entry [{"kind": "worker", "path": "src/index.js"}], harness ["test/harness/**"] and edge ["undici"], and a bound test that imports test/harness/worker.js (which imports src/index.js and calls its fetch with an outbound stand-in), when rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 runs, then the structural check passes; a bound test importing src/routes/pay.js directly fails with "imports src/routes/pay.js (not the app entry or the harness)".

[edge] Given a fixture library whose rcf/test-strength.json declares entry [{"kind": "module", "path": "src/index.js"}] and whose bound test imports the package by its own name (resolved through its exports map to src/index.js), the structural check passes; the same test importing ../src/index.js by relative path also passes (it is the entry), and importing ../src/internal.js fails with the imports finding.

[must-not] rcf audit test-strength never deploys, never opens a network connection of its own and never writes outside rcf/verdicts/<H12>/ in the project, with or without --record; a malformed rcf/test-strength.json (unparsable, an entry kind outside bin, module and worker, or an empty harness list) exits 2 naming the field and runs no test.
